page_content: available.  TDR Availability None of the developers interviewed had a sense of the supply of TDR available today. Most said they would probably use a broker to acquire any necessary TDR. All thought that more transparency in the TDR market would be helpful, in terms of what is currently available and prices paid, potentially through a centralized database. Developers like certainty and therefore a centralized TDR source would remove one of the risk factors from the development process in San Francisco.
